description.narrative: We propose a set of solutions that will facilitate the most marginalized persons to be part of the solution to addressing climate change impacts and associated loss and damage. The solution is anchored on generating strong evidence on the ground through targeted studies in the affected areas where data is collected, analyzed, documented and shared in high level dialogues at national level andinternational fora. At the centre of the policy dialogues, we will do sector coupling to identify what best mix of policies can deliver the best result at least cost. This will be part of the strategy in undertaking studies to support the policy dialogues. We propose to hold national level policy dialogues on Just transition, loss and damage and NDCs. These dialogues are aimed at informing and influencing the policy makers to make decisions that are inclusive, progressive and contribute to achievement of the targets set in NDCs and associated policies. Position papers, short video testimonies and written stories will be collected and shared during thedialogues as part of the tools. We further intend to use mainstream and social media to raise public awareness on these issues suchthat there is citizen pressure that can cause policy makers to address the challengesidentified.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
